1.
Allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking regular bail in FIR No.47/2023 dated 09.02.2023 registered under Sections 376/420/509 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Rani Bagh, Delhi.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

He seeks, and is granted, four weeks to file the Status Report alongwith SCRB and the MLC.
6.
Let the Nominal Roll also be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendant within four weeks.
